records.title: 178th Wing Base Microgrid Construction
records.buyer_or_issuer: DEPT OF DEFENSE / DEPT OF THE ARMY / NATIONAL GUARD BUREAU
records.overview: SAM.gov solicitation for 178th Wing base microgrid construction. The notice describes a base bid for natural gas generators, microgrid controls, and general work, with options for a PV solar array and battery energy storage system.
records.relevance_notes: Relevant to solar EPC, microgrid, and storage contractors because the official notice includes PV Solar Array and Battery Energy Storage System options.

records.title: Solar with Wildlife and Ecosystem Benefits 2 (SolWEB2)
records.buyer_or_issuer: Department of Energy / Golden Field Office
records.overview: Grants.gov listing for Solar with Wildlife and Ecosystem Benefits 2 (SolWEB2), a DOE funding opportunity focused on improving large-scale solar development outcomes for ecosystems, wildlife, communities, and agrivoltaics adoption.
records.relevance_notes: Relevant as a closed Grants.gov solar funding example for testing the draft intake and review-note workflow. It must not be presented as an active opportunity.

change_log.note: Initial non-published draft intake from approved Grants.gov source. Listed as closed because the official listing is archived.
